settings.title: Settings
settings.deleteConfirmBody: This permanently deletes your account, email, and high scores. This cannot be undone.
settings.privacyBody: We store only your email, your password (encrypted), and your game scores. Nothing else. We never show ads and never sell data.
settings.restartNeededBody: The app needs to restart to switch the layout direction. Please close and reopen the app.

snake.name: Snake
snake.howto: Swipe anywhere to steer the snake. Eat the food to grow. Don't hit the walls or yourself. The snake gets faster as it grows!

brickbreaker.name: Brick Breaker
brickbreaker.howto: Slide your finger to move the paddle. Bounce the ball to smash all the bricks. Hit the ball with the paddle's edge to change its angle. You have 3 balls.

paddleduel.name: Paddle Duel
paddleduel.howto: Slide your finger to move your paddle. Return the ball past the computer's paddle to score. First to 7 points wins. The rally gets faster the longer it lasts!

spacedefenders.name: Space Defenders
spacedefenders.howto: Slide your finger to move your ship — it fires automatically. Destroy all the invaders before they reach you. They speed up as their numbers shrink!

meteordodge.name: Meteor Dodge
meteordodge.howto: Slide your finger to steer your ship left and right. Dodge the falling meteors as long as you can. They fall faster and faster — how long can you last?

hauntedmaze.name: Haunted Maze
hauntedmaze.howto: Swipe to move through the maze. Collect every glowing orb while the ghosts hunt you. Grab a power star to turn the tables and chase them instead!

memorymatch.name: Memory Match
memorymatch.howto: Tap a card to flip it, then find its matching partner. Match every pair to win. Fewer moves means a higher score. Take your time — there's no clock.

simonecho.name: Simon Echo
simonecho.howto: Watch and listen as the colors light up, then tap them back in the same order. Each round adds one more step. How long a pattern can you remember?

neonstack.name: Neon Stack
neonstack.howto: Drag left or right to move the falling piece, tap to spin it, and drag down to drop it faster. Fill a complete row to clear it — clear four at once for a huge bonus. The blocks fall faster as you go!

solitaire.name: Solitaire
solitaire.howto: Tap a card to move it automatically to the best spot. Build the four suit piles from Ace to King. In the columns, stack cards in descending order with alternating colors. Tap the deck to draw a new card. Take all the time you need.

roadhopper.name: Road Hopper
roadhopper.howto: Swipe to hop one step at a time. Dodge the cars on the road, then cross the river by riding the logs — never touch the water! Fill all five nests at the top to advance. Watch out: everything moves faster each round.

astroshards.name: Astro Shards
astroshards.howto: Hold the ↺ and ↻ buttons to turn your ship and ▲ to thrust — it fires by itself. Big rocks break into smaller, faster ones. Small rocks are worth the most points. Fly off one edge and you appear on the other!

pixelwings.name: Pixel Wings
pixelwings.howto: Tap anywhere to flap your wings and stay in the air. Glide through the gap between the towers — one point for each tower you pass. One bump and it's over. How far can you fly?

gemdigger.name: Gem Digger
gemdigger.howto: Swipe to dig tunnels through the earth and collect every gem. Two cave creatures are hunting you — but they can only follow your tunnels, so dig wisely! Collect all the gems to win.

skyshield.name: Sky Shield
skyshield.howto: Missiles are falling toward your six cities! Tap the sky to launch an interceptor — its blast destroys everything nearby. Your ammo is limited each wave, so aim ahead of the missiles. Spare ammo and surviving cities earn big bonuses.

ghostsweeper.name: Ghost Sweeper
ghostsweeper.howto: Tap a tile to reveal it. The numbers tell you how many ghosts hide in the neighboring tiles — use logic to work out where they are. Press and hold to place a ward on a suspected ghost. Reveal every safe tile to win. No timer, just thinking.

zombiebop.name: Zombie Bop
zombiebop.howto: Zombies are popping out of the graves! Tap them before they sink back down. The golden skeleton is worth 5× points. You have 60 seconds — they get faster near the end!

pyramidhop.name: Pyramid Hop
pyramidhop.howto: Swipe DIAGONALLY to hop between the cubes — down-left, down-right, up-left, up-right. Every cube you land on lights up; light them all to clear the level. Dodge the tumbling red orbs, and don't hop off the edge!

gemcolumns.name: Gem Columns
gemcolumns.howto: A stack of three gems falls into the well. Drag sideways to steer it, tap to reshuffle the gem order, drag down to drop faster. Line up three or more of a color — across, down, or diagonally — to shatter them. Chains score big!

tilefusion.name: Tile Fusion
tilefusion.howto: Swipe to slide all the tiles. When two matching numbers collide they fuse into one bigger number. Reach the glowing 2048 tile! The game ends when the board is full and nothing can merge. No clock — plan every move.

slidefifteen.name: Slide Fifteen
slidefifteen.howto: Tap any tile in the same row or column as the empty space to slide it over. Arrange the tiles from 1 to 15. Every puzzle is solvable — fewer moves means a higher score, and there's no clock.

neonlights.name: Neon Lights
neonlights.howto: Tapping a lamp flips it and its four neighbors. Turn the whole board dark to clear the round — three rounds, each scrambled deeper. Fewer taps earn more points. Pure logic, no timer.

retroracer.name: Retro Racer
retroracer.howto: Swipe left or right to hop between the three lanes. Slip past the oncoming cars — the road gets faster and busier the farther you drive. One crash ends the run. How far can you go?

moonlander.name: Moon Lander
moonlander.howto: Hold ▲ to fire your engine against gravity, and ◀ ▶ to drift sideways. Land slowly on the green pad — your ship glows blue when you're slow enough to land safely. Fuel is limited! Each landing brings a smaller pad and stronger gravity.

creepycrawler.name: Creepy Crawler
creepycrawler.howto: Slide to move your hunter — it fires by itself. Shoot the crawler weaving down through the tombstones: hit its middle and it splits in two! Every piece you destroy becomes a new tombstone. Don't let it reach you.

divesquadron.name: Dive Squadron
divesquadron.howto: Slide to steer your ship — it fires by itself. Enemies swoop out of formation and dive straight at you. A diving enemy is worth double points — the brave shot pays! Clear the whole squadron to face a faster wave.

eggcatch.name: Egg Catch
eggcatch.howto: Eggs roll down four ramps. Tap a corner of the screen to hold your basket under that ramp. Catch every egg before it falls — drop three and the game is over. They roll faster as your score grows!
